dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), likely compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Program ORCR0030 handles medical treatment category point aggregation for insurance receipts.
evidence: fixed format, max line 80, no EXEC CICS/SQL
50 COPY statements, 52 CALLs typical of GnuCOBOL ORCA system

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing system - specifically point aggregation by treatment category (診療区分別点数集計) for the JMA ORCA standard receipt software used by medical clinics in Japan.
purpose.summary: ORCR0030 is a batch subprogram within the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that aggregates medical treatment points by category for insurance claim receipts (レセプト). It processes various medical billing items including prescriptions, examinations, and procedures, computing point totals and counts for submission to Japanese health insurance bodies. The program has an extensive revision history spanning 2000-2006 covering numerous Japanese health insurance system revisions.

notable_features: 50 COPY statements indicating heavy use of shared copybooks
686 PERFORM statements indicating complex procedural logic
No COMP-3 usage despite financial calculations
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Long revision history with named developers (MCC, NACL teams)
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but contains Japanese EUC-JP encoded text in comments (visible as mojibake). This is characteristic of the JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system, a well-known Japanese healthcare IT system. The program is clearly production-grade with extensive change history dating from 2000 to 2006. Source truncated to first 16000 chars; full program body not visible but mechanical indicators confirm full COBOL structure.
